origin.description: Draw polar coordinates in the plane.
origin.usage: polar(t, r, type='l', col='blue', grcol='darkgrey', bxcol='black', main='Polar Plot', add=FALSE)
origin.details: Cartesian x and y of three radii. R time is that series, not a graphics device.
origin.value: Draw polar coordinates in the plane.
origin.example: { t <- c(0, pi/2, pi); r <- c(1,2,1); pdf(file.path(tempdir(),"p.pdf")); polar(t, r); dev.off(); as.numeric(cbind(r*cos(t), r*sin(t))) }
